requirements.baseline: 3 current channels + pH; one shared RE and CE; not separate galvanically isolated cells.
requirements.acceptance: Confirm physical links, polarity and actual WE-RE control before connecting enzyme electrodes.

requirements.baseline: 4CA requires all physical CH4 selectors in WE mode with power removed and MODE WE acknowledgment.
requirements.acceptance: No mixed jumper state; firmware declaration must match inspected copper links.

requirements.baseline: Four OPA2320 TIA channels; U21-U24 select feedback gain, not the sampled WE.
requirements.acceptance: Validate simultaneous streams, settling and cross-channel response with a dummy cell.

requirements.baseline: Firmware command envelope +/-1.2 V, nominal VSET=2.5 V+E; actual compliance is load dependent.
requirements.acceptance: Numerical maximum actual potential error is TBD; command range is not an accuracy specification.

requirements.baseline: Selected R: 1k/10k/100k/1M ohm with permanent 10M ohm feedback; model includes 3 ohm switch approximation.
requirements.acceptance: Calibrate each board/channel/range/PGA profile; characterize independent points.

requirements.baseline: Firmware limits: +/-1 mA, +/-100 uA, +/-10 uA, +/-1 uA. ADC/PGA and TIA headroom can limit earlier.
requirements.acceptance: Exercise clipping and stop logic with a protected dummy cell; do not interpret limits as validated ranges.

requirements.baseline: ADS131M04, four simultaneous 24-bit conversion channels. CA: nominal 976.5625 SPS/channel at 8 MHz/2/4096.
requirements.acceptance: Measure rate, channel alignment, gaps and clock error. 24-bit coding is not effective resolution.

requirements.baseline: CA default ENBW 1 Hz, output 20 rows/s; configurable ENBW 0.1-10 Hz and output 10-100 rows/s.
requirements.acceptance: Measure actual noise and step response at the recorded filter configuration.

requirements.baseline: DAC80508 16-bit; nominal 0-5 V span on four active outputs with software simultaneous update.
requirements.acceptance: Validate voltage and update timing; DC calibration does not establish dynamic phase accuracy.

requirements.baseline: OPA391 input buffer and driven guard; CH4 voltage limit +/-600 mV, PGA1/2; PH2/PH3 calibration interface.
requirements.acceptance: Actual pH error, input impedance and drift targets are TBD; calibrate the fitted electrode.

requirements.baseline: Manual TEMP input 0-60 °C; no implemented automatic sample-temperature measurement. Battery NTC serves another purpose.
requirements.acceptance: Define actual sample temperature range and uncertainty; 0-60 °C is a software input envelope.

requirements.baseline: Selected channel only: 1-100 Hz default, 0.1 Hz with EISLOW; amplitude >0 to 20 mV peak; |bias|+amplitude <=1.2 V.
requirements.acceptance: Physical magnitude/phase accuracy and usable impedance range remain TBD.

requirements.baseline: 1k/10k: up to 100 Hz; 100k: up to 10 Hz; 1M: CA only. Current and voltage ADCs have separate conversion timing.
requirements.acceptance: Characterize exact frequency/profile; DRDY timestamps are not ADC aperture timestamps.

requirements.baseline: Sampling accepts STOP only. Range/bias changes require global stop. U10 SEL pins share CELL_EN; no per-WE disconnect.
requirements.acceptance: This is an implemented limitation, not a performance target awaiting measurement.

requirements.baseline: USB-C, USB2 Full Speed 12Mbps, USB Serial/JTAG, separate CC Rd resistors. No PD, BLE or Wi-Fi feature in current firmware.
requirements.acceptance: Check both orientations, enumeration and data integrity. Whole-interface 90 ohm compliance is unverified.

requirements.baseline: USB/BQ25180 SYS path, MCU 3.3 V and analog boost/LDO rails. FW 5VA coarse validity window: 4.85-5.15 V.
requirements.acceptance: Measure all rails, ripple, transients and input current; monitor thresholds are not regulator accuracy claims.

requirements.baseline: CELL_EN defaults low; firmware gates START on valid monitors and setup. Power task nominal polling interval 200 ms.
requirements.acceptance: Measure actual electrode state and fault latency, including MCU reset and stalled firmware.

requirements.baseline: External protected 1S LiPo path. FW disables charging after boot; BQ25180 reset state permits charging before FW initialization.
requirements.acceptance: Battery capacity/NTC/charge profile TBD. First bring-up uses USB with battery and sensor disconnected.

requirements.baseline: 4 copper layers, nominal 0.20 mm FPC; outline 41.8x42.5 mm; no permanent stiffener; populated areas need flat support and USB retention.
requirements.acceptance: Bend radius/cycles, connector load and operating temperature are TBD. Flexibility does not establish stretchability.

requirements.baseline: Released DRC0 errors/0 warnings/0 unconnected; ERC0;202 references and 687 physical pads checked for schematic parity.
requirements.acceptance: Read together with recorded ignored check classes. No electrical performance follows from CAD pass.

requirements.baseline: 196 assembled parts,54 BOM SKUs; TOP101/BOTTOM95; BOM/CPL parity checked; nominal coverlay and paste checks recorded.
requirements.acceptance: Factory CAM, placement orientation/origin and FPC reflow/fixture acceptance pending.

requirements.baseline: No accepted numeric error function or minimum quantitative current is established.
requirements.acceptance: Define DeltaI_allow(I,T,B), minimum signal, calibration interval and instrument uncertainty before sign-off.

requirements.baseline: Maximum allowed potential error, electrode Cdl/Rct/Rs and common CE current envelope are not fixed.
requirements.acceptance: Define DeltaE_allow and cell parameter range before claiming regulation performance.

requirements.baseline: Allowable electrical and chemical cross responses are not yet specified; shared-cell EIS may perturb other channels.
requirements.acceptance: Define absolute error per victim channel and normalized coupling for each aggressor/victim pair.

requirements.baseline: Current consumption, efficiency, worst-case power, thermal rise and battery runtime are unmeasured; battery capacity is not selected.
requirements.acceptance: Set duty cycle, load states, capacity and derating assumptions before calculating runtime.

requirements.baseline: CA, pH and experimental selected-channel EIS. No implemented CV/DPV, wireless telemetry, automatic charging policy or quantitative EIS qualification.
requirements.acceptance: Describe RevM20 separately from the earlier AD5941 project and its historical results.

error_budget.value: Rf=(Rselected+3 ohm) parallel10 Mohm; detailed range table below.
error_budget.treatment: 3 ohm is a firmware approximation; calibrate actual fitted path.

error_budget.value: Selected R +/-0.1%; permanent 10M +/-1%. Highest-gain combined DC term approximately +/-0.182%.
error_budget.conversion: Evaluate both parallel resistors at tolerance corners; hold Ron=3 ohm for this term.
error_budget.treatment: Uncalibrated multiplicative error; resistor TCR/self-heating and calibration uncertainty remain separate.

error_budget.value: ADG704 typ 2.5 ohm/max 4 ohm at 25 °C; max 4.5 ohm to 85 °C. FW uses 3 ohm.
error_budget.conversion: At 25 °C use conservative0<=Ron<=4 ohm, other components nominal; range table gives model residual.
error_budget.treatment: Do not add the entire Ron again after calibrating fitted gain. No whole-temperature gain bound claimed.

error_budget.value: On/off leakage magnitude max 100 pA at 25 °C;300 pA over-40..85 °C at specified 5 V-table test conditions.
error_budget.conversion: Each specification is a terminal/test-condition limit, not a complete-board total. Off branches require topology-aware accounting.
error_budget.treatment: Measure zero versus bias/time/temperature. Constant offset calibration does not bound drift.

error_budget.value: TMUX1112 at 5 V/25 °C: on leakage max 25 pA at 2.5 V;100 pA at 1.5/4.5 V test points.
error_budget.conversion: Electrode-side current can include switch leakage; source buffers and humid surfaces also load that node.
error_budget.treatment: Keep terminal conditions with each value; include the actual active/inactive topology.

error_budget.value: OPA2320: max 0.9 pA at 25 °C, specified common-mode and supply conditions.
error_budget.conversion: Direct current offset term; the installed TIAs are OPA2320, not OPA2391.
error_budget.treatment: Review source-buffer leakage separately and measure fitted-board temperature dependence.

error_budget.value: OPA2320 Vos max 150 uV at 25 °C; drift max 5 uV/C under specified temperature test.
error_budget.conversion: Direct current-equivalent term Vos/Rf; also changes actual WE bias and electrode reaction current.
error_budget.treatment: A simple Vos/Rf conversion does not include the chemistry-dependent response to potential error.

error_budget.value: Each 1k resistor +/-0.02%; ideal unloaded alpha spans 0.4999..0.5001. P/N mismatch at 2.5 V can produce 500 uV ADC differential offset.
error_budget.conversion: Equivalent current=500 uV/(0.5*Rf);1.1 nA at the highest-gain model. Example at equal 2.5 V inputs.
error_budget.treatment: Use bias-dependent zero calibration. ADC input loading, resistor TCR and correlation are not included in this example.

error_budget.value: ADS131M04 internal 1.2 V model. Actual gain/offset/drift at selected PGA, OSR and source impedance await characterization.
error_budget.conversion: For already input-referred ADC voltage uncertainty, DeltaI=DeltaV_ADC_input/(0.5*Rf). Account for PGA gain uncertainty separately.
error_budget.treatment: Do not insert datasheet 4 kSPS noise as the measured 976.5625 SPS plus 1 Hz-filter result; avoid counting included reference errors twice.

error_budget.value: 24-bit bipolar conversion: LSB=1.2 V/(2^23*PGA); PGA1 current code steps listed below.
error_budget.treatment: Code step is neither noise floor nor current accuracy; ideal quantization RMS requires a suitable statistical model.

error_budget.value: At 25 °C and 1 Hz ENBW, resistor-only input noise approximately 4.052..0.135 pA RMS across the four modeled ranges.
error_budget.conversion: sqrt(4*kB*T*B/Rf), assuming an ideal DC feedback resistance and white noise.
error_budget.treatment: Partial model only: op-amp voltage/current noise, noise gain, dividers, ADC,1/f and cell are excluded.

error_budget.value: Nominal DAC code step 76.29395 uV; nearest rounding half-step 38.14697 uV; DAC80508 INL max 1 LSB under stated code/load conditions.
error_budget.conversion: 5 V/65536. Envelope endpoints can be moved inward one code by firmware.
error_budget.treatment: Keep rounding, INL, DAC gain/offset and fitted calibration residual as distinct terms.

error_budget.value: Internal 2.5 V initial accuracy max+/-5 mV; reference-only scale example+/-0.2% of E.
error_budget.conversion: Ideal shared-reference relation E=(2*code/65536-1)*Vref; at 1.2 V the term is+/-2.4 mV, with first-order cancellation atE=0.
error_budget.treatment: This correlation excludes DAC gain/offset, buffer offsets and load effects; do not add two independent absolute 2.5 V-reference errors.

error_budget.value: DeltaE includes I_WE*Ron_WE and a cell-geometry-dependent solution transfer resistance. Example 10 uA*1 kohm=10 mV.
error_budget.conversion: Actual electrode-side WE-RE measurement is required. The example is not measured patch resistance.
error_budget.treatment: Static near-zero-load DAC calibration does not remove arbitrary load-dependent voltage drop.

error_budget.value: R4=100 ohm; same-polarity sum 3 mA gives 0.30 V resistor drop before switch/cell polarization.
error_budget.conversion: I_CE is the signed sum of all WE currents. This example does not qualify 3 mA operation.
error_budget.treatment: Sweep summed load and cell capacitance; CE_MON reads the driver before R4, not the electrode surface.

error_budget.value: Input-buffer leakage*electrode source resistance, differential buffer offsets, reference drift and temperature remain separate terms.
error_budget.conversion: Delta pH=DeltaV/|fitted electrode slope|. Ideal25C Nernst slope is about 59.16 mV/pH; use measured electrode slope.
error_budget.treatment: Sample-temperature measurement and pH accuracy targets are TBD. Battery NTC is not a sample sensor.

error_budget.value: Different current/voltage ADC filters, clocks, ISR delays, TIA transfer and DAC updates contribute to complex-ratio error.
error_budget.conversion: Compare conventional Z=-V/I to characterized R/RC at the exact channel/frequency/range/PGA/filter/calibration profile.
error_budget.treatment: Keep EIS_ACTUAL_UNVERIFIED. A fitted DC coefficient or modeled delay does not qualify phase.

error_budget.value: Supply coupling, FPC/connector humidity leakage, temperature drift, electrode selectivity and H2O2 transport have no measured bound.
error_budget.conversion: Electrical aggressor/victim tests and single-analyte enzyme controls must be evaluated separately.
error_budget.treatment: No total worst-case accuracy or LOD can be calculated while these terms and numerical requirements are unresolved.

validation.title: Released CAD and manufacturing files
validation.method: Review hash-bound DRC/ERC, BOM/CPL, coverlay/paste and schematic-pad parity records.
validation.acceptance: No recorded violation in enabled checks; identify all excluded checks; manufacturer approval remains separate.
validation.result: Existing release audits:DRC0/ERC0/unconnected0;202 references/687 pads;54 BOM SKUs/196 fitted parts. Reviewed, not rerun here.

validation.title: Selector and pin mapping
validation.method: Read J1/U10/U21-24/U14/U25 net connections and final PH link audit; inspect physical links after assembly.
validation.acceptance: Default 3CA+pH, matching declaration; no unintentional TIA connection to pH. Physical inspection still pending.
validation.result: Logical connections and nominal PH link copper confirmed from released CAD; no assembled board inspected.

validation.title: First power-up and reset
validation.method: USB only, sensor/battery disconnected; current-limited supply, scope CELL_EN/rails/reset and repeat cold/MCU resets.
validation.acceptance: No unintended electrode connection; rail sequence consistent with component limits. Repeat count and reset waveform envelope recorded.

validation.title: Rail quality and power
validation.method: Measure3V3_D/3V3_A/5V_A/DAC_AVDD at rest/acquisition/USB traffic and defined dummy loads; record ripple bandwidth and current.
validation.acceptance: 5VA coarse FW window 4.85..5.15 V; other rail, ripple, transient and power budgets must be fixed before qualification.

validation.title: USB power and plug orientations
validation.method: Enumerate in both USB-C orientations; record inrush, SYS/rail startup, disconnect and brownout behavior.
validation.acceptance: Both orientations work without rail excursions beyond device limits; defined test count and fault behavior reported.

validation.title: USB signal and data integrity
validation.method: Exercise console/programming and sustained timestamped data; scope interface only with suitable probes.
validation.acceptance: No unexplained loss/reset in a declared duration and host/cable matrix. USB impedance/compliance is a separate claim.

validation.title: Acquisition rate and data flags
validation.method: Log raw four-channel frames and sequence/DRDY timing at each required OSR/PGA/filter setting.
validation.acceptance: Rate compared with nominal 976.5625 SPS; observed clock tolerance, gaps and clipping flags reported. Output 20rows/s is not ADC sample rate.

validation.title: Actual WE-RE DC accuracy
validation.method: Use calibrated high-input-impedance DMM, defined dummy cell and independent interior/endpoint points before and after DACCAL.
validation.acceptance: Max/RMS residual plus instrument uncertainty <=DeltaE_allow, presently TBD. Sweep current as well as command.

validation.title: Loop stability and compliance
validation.method: Scope electrode-side WE-RE and CE during safe steps across R_s/R_ct/C_dl and same-polarity total loads, all required gains.
validation.acceptance: No sustained oscillation; settling/overshoot, allowed cell range and voltage error limits TBD before qualification.

validation.title: Current transfer and calibration
validation.method: Floating/isolated calibrated current or characterized dummy cell; zero and signed points per channel/range/PGA; independent validation points.
validation.acceptance: Report error versus current, linearity and combined uncertainty againstDeltaI_allow(I,T,B), currently TBD. Respect tighter ADC/headroom limits.

validation.title: Zero, noise and usable minimum current
validation.method: Document input termination, warm-up, raw/filtered PSD and RMS, duration, ENBW, bias, temperature and EMI conditions.
validation.acceptance: Report measured input noise and drift; establish minimum quantitative current from agreed signal/error criterion, not ADC code step.

validation.title: Bias-dependent and switch leakage
validation.method: Record zero versus WE bias/range, temperature and time; separate dry-board, connector and fixture leakage controls.
validation.acceptance: Residual after offset/gain/bias fit stays within the assigned leakage budget, which must first be defined.

validation.title: Shared-cell electrical coupling
validation.method: Without enzymes, step one channel load using an isolated dummy network; record all I, victim WE-RE and CE. Repeat each aggressor/victim pair.
validation.acceptance: Report both absoluteDeltaI_victim andDeltaI_victim/DeltaI_aggressor with voltage disturbance; thresholds TBD. Preserve real shared impedances.

validation.title: ADC, supply and digital coupling
validation.method: Keep analog loads fixed; apply activity to other channels, USB and SPI; compare raw/filteredI and supply spectra.
validation.acceptance: Assign an absolute error/noise budget before judging pass; distinguish ADC coupling from shared-cell effects.

validation.title: pH calibration and loading
validation.method: Use certified buffers at measured sample temperature; PH2/PH3 fit then independent buffers; characterize electrode source impedance/loading.
validation.acceptance: Residual pH, drift and temperature uncertainty <=agreedpH tolerance, currently TBD.

validation.title: Chemical coupling and pH disturbance
validation.method: Add glucose alone, then lactate/other target alone while recording all channels; include enzyme-free PB control and actual PAH/flow geometry.
validation.acceptance: Report concentration-equivalent cross responses andpH shifts at defined analyte, flow and oxygen conditions; acceptance TBD.

validation.title: EIS complex-ratio calibration
validation.method: Use characterized passiveR/RC with traceable complexZ; validate independent loads at each exact frequency/profile and quantifyV/I timing.
validation.acceptance: Magnitude/phase tolerances and usableZ range TBD; preserve raw traces and unverified flag until qualified.

validation.title: EIS effect on other channels
validation.method: Run selected-channel EIS in the shared dummy/chemical cell and compare all other current/pH channels with CA-only baseline.
validation.acceptance: Quantify disturbance; do not label other channels independent concentration measurements without a suitable criterion.

validation.title: Limits and global stop
validation.method: Induce protected overrange, ADC clipping, stale/invalid monitor and allowed communication faults; scope actual cell isolation.
validation.acceptance: Verify global stop and record physical latency. No claim of independent per-WE stop;200 ms is a polling setting, not guaranteed fault latency.

validation.title: Calibration persistence and invalidation
validation.method: Change range/PGA/DAC fit and restart; inspect valid masks, CRC rejection, profile binding and safe-start behavior.
validation.acceptance: Stale/corrupt coefficients cannot silently qualify a different profile; actual fits remain linked to board serial and instrument record.

validation.title: Battery qualification
validation.method: After choosing capacity/protection/NTC/profile, validate charger registers, power path, cold reset, USB removal and discharge at defined loads.
validation.acceptance: Battery-specific current/voltage/temperature limits and runtime target TBD; firmware-after-boot charging-off does not qualify pre-boot behavior.

validation.title: Manufacturer CAM and assembly
validation.method: Obtain factory review of stackup, vias/slots, panel rails, fixture, bottom module reflow and actual component origins/orientations.
validation.acceptance: Explicit CAM/placement/reflow disposition with customer confirmation; a quote or browser preview is not approval.

validation.title: Temperature and humidity
validation.method: Repeat zero/gain/pH/coupling under defined temperature/RH and wet-connector conditions with sample temperature measured separately.
validation.acceptance: Environmental range, leakage and drift budgets TBD; keep drying/recovery data and calibration age.

validation.title: Mechanical and thermal behavior
validation.method: Record flat-supported baseline, connector retention and defined bend/strain cycles; repeat electrical checks and measure self-heating.
validation.acceptance: Bend radius, cycle count, fixture/load and strain requirement TBD. FPC bendability does not demonstrate stretchable electronics.

validation.title: Board-to-board repeatability
validation.method: Assign serial numbers to the planned 5boards; repeat accepted functional/calibration tests and record assembly or calibration failures.
validation.acceptance: Report n, exclusions, distribution and worst board. A5-board pilot does not establish production yield or long-term reliability.
